scope: Non-NVIDIA ASR families beyond Parakeet derivatives, verified by primary-source config and license rather than file-size estimates.

verdicts.base_license: apache-2.0 (verified on the base repo, ungated)
verdicts.contract: raw 16 kHz waveform [batch, num_samples]; conv feature frontend inside the graph; blank id 0; 10288 tokens with real spaces; 320 samples per frame; no length input
verdicts.reuse: normalizeWav2Vec2Waveform plus the shared CtcDecoder; no mel frontend parity work.
verdicts.oracle: The repack ships four test clips (de/en/es/fr) whose audio is downloadable. The model card spot check uses different por/swh clips that are not obtainable, so the gate uses the shipped clips with a recorded baseline hypothesis, labeled self-consistency rather than upstream-oracle parity.
known_limits: No length input means batching and long-form need external windowing through the library windowing machinery.
Per-utterance zero-mean unit-variance normalization is a caller responsibility, as in the wav2vec2 family.

verdicts.reason: Ships audio_encoder_whisper_int8.onnx, so it is a Whisper export rather than a new family.
Indic conformer CTC with real Indic coverage, but the repository layout is messy and the graph input contract is unverified. Worth a pass after omnilingual CTC.
Decoder-only seq2seq export requiring a separate encoder; substantially larger family work than a CTC port.
BitNet weights need a custom kernel that no execution provider here provides, the same wall parakeet-redux hits.

qwen3_asr_note: Every qwen3-asr-* record in the widened survey is a repack of the already-ported qwen-asr family, so they are supply-chain options, not new ports.
filter_lesson_applied: Parameter counts and sizes are read from each model config, never inferred from download size; that mistake produced the parakeet-redux error.
